# Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue containing exploit details or credentials. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository if enabled, or contact the repository maintainer through a private channel. Include affected version, impact, and a safe reproduction. Do not include real vessel telemetry or secrets.

This repository is a reference implementation and is not a certified safety system. See [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md) for deployment controls and its security boundary.
